g.text: Fitness: is any representation type better, irrespective of embedding?
faint line = one embedding (17 total); ◆ = mean (95% bootstrap CI); Friedman p = omnibus test
letters = compact letter display — types sharing a letter are not significantly different (pairwise Wilcoxon, BH-FDR; shown only when Friedman is significant)
